purpose: Short, reproducible developer workflows; exact signatures are in public-api.index.json

workflows.taskZh: 核验带内容物资箱和容器的整图交付，检查子物品缺失重复与变动
workflows.taskEn: Audit filled crate and container delivery graphs for missing duplicate or changed children
workflows.boundary: One caller native handoff; fresh managed graph evidence, no old-wrapper access/retry/save. Cold-load recovery confirms current root only; persist expected manifests separately.

workflows.taskZh: 创建已填充物资箱、随机模块、真品注射器，避免空箱模板
workflows.taskEn: Create filled loot crates, random modules and a genuine injector rather than empty templates
workflows.boundary: Current game thread/run/build; one random native factory, no automatic reroll/delivery/save or existing item repair. Populated crates require graph-aware delivery reconciliation.

workflows.taskZh: 礼包订单物品发放、防止重复领奖、交付凭据、读档恢复对账
workflows.taskEn: Gift/order delivery receipts, duplicate reward prevention and reload reconciliation
workflows.boundary: Stable caller ledger required. No automatic handoff/retry/save; no old wrapper access after native handoff; absence after attempt remains uncertain.

workflows.taskZh: 筛选图片黑图、全透明图、图集邻图和紧密打包精灵
workflows.taskEn: Inspect black/transparent artwork, atlas crops and tightly packed sprites
workflows.boundary: Only Inspected carries content evidence. GPU is synchronous; no automatic stock eligibility, caching, original-art export or source mutation.

workflows.taskZh: 订货发货：设置普通货物、赃物和固定热度
workflows.taskEn: Prepare delivery origin: ordinary/stolen and fixed heat
workflows.boundary: Live native item, current main thread/run. Fixed zero differs from native initialization; Indeterminate requires reconciliation. No delivery/payment/save.

workflows.taskZh: 从原版与全部 Mod 物品筛选货源、图鉴和原生价值
workflows.taskEn: Build stock/encyclopedias from all native and Mod items
workflows.boundary: CaptureIdentifiers executes no factories; Step explicitly reads detached unowned factory metadata across frames. Inspect failures; refresh after locale/load changes; artwork acceptance separate.

workflows.taskZh: 扩展阵营和权益、原版效果悬停展示
workflows.taskEn: Extend factions and effects with native hover details
workflows.boundary: Presentation only. Native storeReputations auto discovery; provider owns gameplay and saves. Bottom details use hover, effect switching and text pages, no scrollbar.

workflows.taskZh: 原版UI积木、上下居中与AI预览测量
workflows.taskEn: Native UI components, vertical centering and AI preview measurements
workflows.boundary: Ordinary developer mode. Native fonts and geometry only; no callbacks, item grants or saves.

workflows.taskZh: 离线生成中英双语 JSON 或 DLL 起步工程并选择 Tooltip 风格
workflows.taskEn: Generate a bilingual JSON or DLL starter and choose a Tooltip recipe offline
workflows.boundary: Fresh directory only. Does not install, generate native items or save. MATERIAL is an example; adjust actual gameplay types.

workflows.taskZh: 离线查找中文任务、英文 API 完整重载签名与错误处理
workflows.taskEn: Search SDK tasks, exact API overload signatures and error handling offline
workflows.boundary: Reads shipped indexes; no game DLL loading. Check exact member IDs and each API lifecycle before use.

workflows.taskZh: 选择原版或扩展物品 Tooltip 风格，规范简介与风味摆放
workflows.taskEn: Choose native or extended item Tooltip style and separate instructions from narrative
workflows.boundary: Recipes use existing fields, not tooltipStyle. Native style explicitly disables ShowSource; preserve native properties and other Mods. Late does not guarantee a final line.

workflows.taskZh: 不用 C# 添加物品
workflows.next: Validate dependencies with --packs on the complete root; then inspect directory Applied state in the game.
workflows.boundary: Validation and Accepted are not player delivery or gameplay verification.

workflows.taskZh: 独立编译一个最小 DLL Mod
workflows.taskEn: Build a minimal independent DLL Mod
workflows.install: Copy only the caller DLL into Mods while the game is closed. EZapi and MelonLoader remain separately installed.
workflows.boundary: Change the author namespace and stable item ID before publishing; do not copy a second framework/runtime DLL.

workflows.taskZh: 跟随游戏设置显示名称、Tooltip、对话和机器标签
workflows.taskEn: Follow game language for names, tooltips, dialogue and machine labels
workflows.boundary: CSV can use additional official locales. Resolve again on refresh/reopen. Reply with context.LocaleCode; no independent language setting.

workflows.taskZh: 保存物品升级或自定义状态
workflows.taskEn: Store item upgrades or custom state
workflows.boundary: Read then Stage with the returned revision. StagedInMemory is not disk persistence; preserve unknown versions and reconcile Indeterminate.

workflows.taskZh: 为机器、对话和奖励复用资格判断
workflows.taskEn: Reuse eligibility checks across machines, dialogue and rewards
workflows.boundary: CLI validates declarations; RequirementApi.Evaluate reads current-run facts without purchase or unlock. Unknown does not become false under negation.

workflows.taskZh: 给原生离店地图增加自适应外出地点按钮
workflows.taskEn: Add adaptive native departure destination buttons
workflows.boundary: UI and guarded callback dispatch only. C# behavior required; no automatic travel, visit debit, inventory transfer or save.

workflows.taskZh: 生成贴近原版画风的物品图片
workflows.taskEn: Create item artwork matching the original game
workflows.boundary: Original artwork is excluded from MIT. Pixel canvas is independent of inventory shape; no new asset-size loading restriction.

workflows.taskZh: 向王尔德人脉网络添加兼容条目或分类
workflows.boundary: Discover live NetworkElement descendants and category roots; preserve native callbacks and IDs. Private replacement canvases need explicit integration.

verificationPolicy: Compile caller against the exact framework DLL. Build verifies the minimal DLL and examples; runtime reports require their own hash/build/process/scope.

documentationContext.evidencePolicy: Only explicitly scoped current-DLL observations apply. Historical evidence never transfers.
